name: AbInBev CDP
description: Webform handler that maps webform submissions to AB InBev CDP (Treasure Data) fields and posts them to the CDP postback API. Supports multiple per-webform configurations.
project_description: AbInBev CDP integration for Drupal. Provides a single Webform submission handler ("CDP Settings Handler") that maps webform fields to AB InBev Customer Data Platform attributes and POSTs each submission to the Treasure Data postback API (in.treasuredata.com). Field mappings, consent/purpose flags, campaign metadata, country/zone, dev-vs-prod switch and the CDP write keys are all configured per handler instance, so multiple webforms can each target the CDP with their own configuration. Includes an optional 18+ age-gate driven by a mapped birthday field.
